actions.R: clear all resting orders for the instrument
actions.C: cancel the event size from a resting order and remove it at zero
actions.M: replace price and size; a missing order is treated as an add
actions.T: aggressing trade record; no direct book mutation
actions.F: resting fill record; no direct book mutation

priority.add: append at the end of its price-level queue

provider_semantics.event_boundary: inspect reconstructed book state only after F_LAST
provider_semantics.snapshot: F_SNAPSHOT clear record followed by zero or more adds; final record carries F_LAST

implementations.primary: order map plus explicit price levels, aggregate depth, ordered queues, and lazy best-price heaps
implementations.reference: independent order-only map with priority ordinals and price-level reconstruction at checkpoints

reported_but_not_rejected.modify_without_prior_order: apply as add and report count and rate, as specified by provider semantics
reported_but_not_rejected.empty_book_side_at_event_boundary: report count; an empty side is not a crossed book
reported_but_not_rejected.event_timestamp_regressions: report separately because receive time is the replay ordering key
reported_but_not_rejected.sequence_regressions: report separately and do not infer market meaning
